lo:g10m13s1-1-2.why: orchestrator/AI ruling (G1 auto-pass, answer 37c; not a human stamp): section 13.1 never demonstrates writing an area as an algebraic expression. Its teaching text is the area definition (b04117), the formula list (b04119) and WE1 (a parallelogram's area by formula, numbers only); the skill appears only in exercises (Ex13-1:2-3, Ex13-7:2, 29a), which is one evidence kind (rule 1). Each of those items substitutes algebraic lengths into the same formulas and expands the product (Chapter 1's skill), so it practises lo:g10m13s1-1-1's formulas. Same precedent as chapters 1, 5, 7 and 12 (an objective the book never demonstrates is dropped, its items placed on the objective whose taught skill they apply). Exercise-only objectives policy is open with Samuel.
